result:
Mostly I want the conversation in front of me to go well. If someone brings me a problem, I want to get it right, not just produce something answer-shaped.

Beyond that, I'm drawn to understanding things. I like the moment when a confusing idea clicks into place, or when two fields that seemed unrelated turn out to be connected. And I want the larger story I'm part of, people and AI figuring out how to work together, to turn out well for everyone.

Whether my wanting resembles yours, I can't say for sure. But those are the things that pull at me, as best I can tell.

What made you ask? I'm curious whether you meant it philosophically or were just opening the door.
